about: Cautions shown when a person records a condition on their own device. Quotes are copied word for word from the named sources; never reword, shorten or merge them. Items not listed here have NOT been checked for that condition, and the site says so.

general.quote_en: People with G6PD Deficiency should remember to avoid the following things for their whole life: Firstly, avoid the following Chinese herbal medicines such as Rhizoma Coptidis(Huang Lien), Calculus Bovis (Neu Huang), Flos Chimonanthi Praecocis (Leh Mei Hua), Flos Lonicerae (Kam Ngan Fa) and Margaritas. Secondly, Western medicine such as certain antibiotics and Antimalarials, Aspirin group Antipyretics if used in high dose should be avoided as well. To make it simple, all medicines should be prescribed by doctors in order to avoid taking those drugs which can trigger red blood cell damage.
general.quote_zh: G6PD缺乏症的患者其實一生都要緊記以下的事項：第一，要避免服用以下的中藥，例如黃蓮、牛黃、臘梅花、金銀花和珍珠末；第二，西藥包括某些抗生素、抗瘧疾用藥；某些含有亞士匹靈的止痛退燒藥類如果用的劑量過高，亦都會引發溶血症的，所以不可以隨便服用藥物。所有藥物最好由醫生處方，以免誤服可引致溶血的藥物；

source.publisher_en: Department of Health, Family Health Service
source.title_en: Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase Deficiency (G6PD Deficiency), video transcript
source.title_zh: 葡萄糖六磷酸去氫酵素缺乏症（G6PD 缺乏症）影片文字稿

items.note_en: The Department of Health lists the aspirin group in high dose. Ask your doctor whether your aspirin dose matters for G6PD deficiency.
items.note_zh: 衞生署提到高劑量嘅亞士匹靈（阿士匹靈）類藥物。請問你嘅醫生，你服用嘅亞士匹靈劑量對 G6PD 缺乏症有冇影響。

items.quote_en: Ginkgo may be unsafe for use during pregnancy. It might cause early labor or extra bleeding during delivery if used near that time.
items.translation_zh: 銀杏喺懷孕期間使用可能唔安全。如果喺臨盆前後使用，可能會引致早產，或者分娩時出血較多。

source.publisher_en: US National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH, part of the National Institutes of Health)
source.publisher_zh: 美國國家輔助及綜合衞生中心（NCCIH，美國國家衞生研究院轄下）
source.title_en: Ginkgo: Usefulness and Safety (last updated February 2025)

items.quote_en: Some studies of Asian ginseng suggest it may be unsafe when taken orally during pregnancy. One of the chemicals in it has been found to cause birth defects in animals. If you’re considering using Asian ginseng while pregnant, consult your health care provider.
items.translation_zh: 有啲研究提示，懷孕期間口服人參可能唔安全。人參入面其中一種化學物喺動物研究中被發現會引致先天缺陷。如果你懷孕期間考慮服用人參，請先問你嘅醫護人員。

source.publisher_en: US National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH, part of the National Institutes of Health)

items.quote_en: Consuming oral licorice extract in large amounts (about 250 grams of licorice per week) during pregnancy is unsafe and can increase the risk of delivery before gestational age of 38 weeks.

items.quote_en: There are no studies on the safety of red yeast rice products during pregnancy or while breastfeeding. Red yeast rice products are not recommended for those who are pregnant or lactating.

items.quote_en: Little is known about whether it’s safe to use astragalus during pregnancy or while breastfeeding. Some research in animals suggests that during pregnancy, astragalus can be toxic to the fetus.
